item.description: Vermont's law enforcement dispatch system was taken offline Monday night due to a potential security incident. The system manages records and dispatches for police across the state. Officials have not yet shared details on when it will be restored.

Lake Placid's Olympic Regional Development Authority generated nearly four hundred eighty-four million dollars in economic impact last year. The venues attracted one point three million visitors, most staying overnight. ORDA-supported activities also sustained nearly three thousand eight hundred jobs and contributed thirty-six million dollars in taxes.

A former Rutland County deputy was permanently banned from police work for sending a racist message. The Vermont Criminal Justice Council unanimously revoked Ryder Paskevich's law enforcement certification. Paskevich admitted his conduct was inappropriate and expressed remorse.

Killington has lost three town employees amid workplace conflicts. Longtime bookkeeper Mona Hickory resigned citing a toxic environment and alleged harassment. Police Sgt. Mike Hoffman and Road Foreman Chad Galiano also resigned, and the town is searching for replacements.
